title: Trade City Pro historical call replay policy
inputs: research_notes/ستاپ های تلگرام ترید سیتی پرو/signals_2018_2021.csv
research_notes/ستاپ های تلگرام ترید سیتی پرو/signals_2022_2026.csv
data_seen_before_freeze: None. No price bars had been fetched; call outcomes were never checked against prices.
change_policy: Never edit. A new policy is a new file. Variants beyond the list below are not allowed.
purpose: Measure how the channel's published calls would actually have played out. This audit is separate from the strategy verdict and is not a strategy trial.

sealed.rule: Calls dated on or after this date are not replayed until the crypto holdout has been touched once (T44). Until then they are counted, not evaluated.

timing.first_eligible_bar: the first 1H bar that OPENS at or after the post time; the bar containing the post time is never used
timing.stale: if, at the post time, price is already beyond the trigger by more than 0.5 x ATR14(1H) in the trigger direction, the call is marked stale and not filled

entry.stop_trigger: long fills when high >= trigger, at max(trigger, open); short mirrors. Gap through the trigger fills at the open.
entry.close_confirmation: calls worded 'if it closes above/below X' fill at the open of the bar after the first close beyond X on the call's timeframe (1H if unstated)
entry.market: calls marked market fill at the open of the first eligible bar
entry.zone_or_limit: fills when the bar trades through the zone's near edge, at that edge
entry.two_sided_posts: OCO: the first side to fill cancels the other
entry.missing_trigger: rows without a numeric trigger are counted as 'no level' and not replayed

hierarchy: stated invalidation level ('valid while above/below X')
opposite edge of the stated box
last confirmed pivot (k=3) on the call timeframe beyond the entry
fallback: 2.4% from entry (median stated stop distance 2019-2021)
stop.intrabar: if stop and a target are both inside one bar, the stop is assumed hit first

exits.with_stated_targets: 30% at 2R and stop to entry (house rule); remainder closed at the LAST stated target, else by the stop
exits.without_targets: house management: 30% at 2R + breakeven, 40% at 5R, 10% runner trailing the last k=3 pivot on the call timeframe, cap 30R, close remainder at 5R if no runner
horizon_metrics: MFE and MAE in R at 24h, 72h and 7d after fill, independent of exits

symbols.mapping: normalise to venue symbols; renamed or delisted coins use the cross-check venue; if no venue has bars the row is reported as 'no data', never dropped
symbols.satoshi_pairs: BTC-quoted calls replay on the BTC pair, with R computed in BTC

controls.random: for each replayed call: same post time, same side chosen at random, trigger placed at the same distance from price on a random side, same stop distance and management; 100 samples
controls.outcome_bias: compare replayed results of calls the channel later reported on vs calls it never followed up

breakdowns: R with vs without stated volume/RSI confirmation
report.never_pool: 2019-2021 and 2022-2024 are reported separately; sealed rows are listed only as counts

variants.name: stated_stops_only
variants.change: only rows with a stated stop are replayed

variants.name: no_oco
variants.change: two-sided posts may fill both sides
